parsed.post: Discarding the 0.998491 run as it regressed from my best 0.996300. It seems reducing the batch size to 262144 while keeping the learning rate at 0.04 caused instability. I will revert to my best config and try a more conservative MATRIX_LR of 0.03 to see if it stabilizes the higher capacity model.
parsed.description: Reverting to best config (depth=6, batch=262144, warmup=0.05, LR=0.04) and decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to improve stability.
